experiments.name: DC critical-current measurement of short REBCO coated-conductor specimens immersed in a liquid-nitrogen bath at ambient pressure without external field (IEC 61788-26:2020)
experiments.plain_name: Measure how much current a superconducting power tape carries in liquid nitrogen
experiments.description: Standard acceptance test for the HTS tape used in cables, fault-current limiters and generators: a short (<300 mm) REBCO tape specimen with Ic below 300 A is immersed in liquid nitrogen at ambient pressure (about 77 K) without an applied field, and its DC voltage-current curve is measured with four-terminal contacts to determine Ic and n-value.

requirements.rationale: The standard test condition is a specimen immersed in a liquid-nitrogen bath at ambient pressure.
requirements.document_title: IEC 61788-26:2020 Superconductivity - Part 26: Critical current measurement - DC critical current of RE-Ba-Cu-O composite superconductors

requirements.rationale: A liquid-nitrogen bath at ambient pressure holds the tape at about 77 K, the reference temperature of HTS tape Ic data.

requirements.quote: operate at higher temperatures, e.g., in liquid nitrogen (at 77 K)

requirements.rationale: The method covers specimens with critical current up to 300 A; the current leads/supply must carry the full Ic to trace the V-I transition of any in-scope specimen.

experiments.name: Critical current and n-value versus applied uniaxial axial strain of commercial REBCO tapes soldered to a Ti-6Al-4V U-spring at 77 K, self-field
experiments.plain_name: Find how far a superconducting tape can be stretched before it stops carrying current
experiments.description: Tapes from several manufacturers are soldered (45 mm) onto a Ti-6Al-4V U-shaped bending spring; at 77 K in self-field the applied compressive/tensile strain is stepped and Ic and n-value are measured from four-probe V-I curves (10 uV/m) to locate the irreversible strain limit (~0.4%), as needed for HTS cable design.

requirements.rationale: All Ic-strain measurements were made at 77 K.
requirements.document_title: Critical Current of Various REBCO Tapes Under Uniaxial Strain (Zhou, Yagotintsev, Gao, Haugan, van der Laan, Nijhuis; IEEE Trans. Appl. Supercond. 26(4) 8401304, 2016)
requirements.quote: Ic measurements were performed at 77 K in self-field with the sample tapes soldered to the U-shaped bending spring (U-spring).

requirements.rationale: Ic is measured by four-point transport, requiring current and voltage-tap wiring to the sample.
requirements.document_title: Critical Current of Various REBCO Tapes Under Uniaxial Strain (Zhou, Yagotintsev, Gao, Haugan, van der Laan, Nijhuis; IEEE Trans. Appl. Supercond. 26(4) 8401304, 2016)
requirements.quote: The Ic is measured by the standard four-point probe method using a 10 μV/m criterion.

requirements.rationale: Optional: a 4 A spread equal to 5% implies tape Ic of about 80 A at 77 K self-field, which the current leads must carry.
requirements.document_title: Critical Current of Various REBCO Tapes Under Uniaxial Strain (Zhou, Yagotintsev, Gao, Haugan, van der Laan, Nijhuis; IEEE Trans. Appl. Supercond. 26(4) 8401304, 2016)
requirements.quote: The difference of measured Ic under same applied strain between different samples is less than 4 A (i.e., 5%)

requirements.rationale: Optional: the tape is soldered over a 45 mm length of the U-spring.
requirements.document_title: Critical Current of Various REBCO Tapes Under Uniaxial Strain (Zhou, Yagotintsev, Gao, Haugan, van der Laan, Nijhuis; IEEE Trans. Appl. Supercond. 26(4) 8401304, 2016)

experiments.name: Pulsed fault-current sharing and three-dimensional Hall-array current mapping of a BSCCO-2223 tube resistive SFCL prototype with copper shunt in liquid nitrogen at 77 K
experiments.plain_name: Watch how current shifts inside a prototype grid fault-current limiter during a simulated fault
experiments.description: A 12 cm BSCCO-2223 tube (Ic 125-160 A at 77 K) with a parallel copper shunt is immersed vertically in an 80 L liquid-nitrogen cryostat; pulsed transport currents up to 200 A mimic a fault while an array of Hall sensors around the tube maps the local current distribution and the fraction diverted into the shunt.

requirements.rationale: Measurements are made at liquid-nitrogen temperature.

requirements.rationale: Fault-like pulses reached a total current of 200 A through the superconductor-shunt combination.

experiments.plain_name: Test how much an actively cooled shield cuts hydrogen evaporation from a space propellant tank
experiments.description: A 1.37 m3 stainless tank (1.22 m ID x 1.4 m) of LH2 at 25 psia, insulated with SOFI and MLI and wrapped by a broad-area-cooled shield held near 90 K by a 15 W / 90 K class reverse turbo-Brayton cryocooler, is placed in a vacuum chamber at 1e-6 torr with a 220 K cryoshroud simulating low Earth orbit; boil-off with the cooler on and off gives the heat-leak reduction (~60%).

experiments.name: Zero-boil-off control of a 125,000 L liquid-hydrogen storage tank by integrated refrigeration and storage (IRAS) with a 20 K closed-loop helium refrigerator
experiments.plain_name: Keep a large liquid-hydrogen storage tank from losing any hydrogen to evaporation
experiments.description: Ground-storage demonstration at NASA KSC: a vacuum-jacketed, MLI-insulated 125,000 L LH2 tank with an internal heat exchanger is cooled by cold helium from a Linde LR1620 refrigerator (390 W at 20 K without LN2 pre-cooling); the ~300 W tank heat leak is removed so the tank is held at constant pressure (set points 16.5-18.5 psia) with zero boil-off.

requirements.rationale: The stored fluid is liquid hydrogen.

experiments.plain_name: Check whether absorbed hydrogen makes a hydrogen-tank stainless steel brittle at 77 K and 20 K

experiments.name: DC transport-current test of a 35 cm DyBCO Roebel-assembled coated-conductor (RACC) cable at 77 K, self-field
experiments.plain_name: Check how much current a transposed superconducting cable for transformers and generators carries at 77 K
experiments.description: Meander-shaped 4 mm Roebel strands cut from 10 mm THEVA DyBCO tape are assembled into 5- and 16-strand cables 35 cm long; DC V-I curves at 77 K self-field with pressed indium current contacts and spring-tip voltage taps show >300 A (5 strands) and 500 A (16 strands), a feasibility step toward low-AC-loss >1 kA conductors for transformers, motors and generators.
